questions.kind: Sources disagree (status report green vs later RAID/meeting: 2 weeks behind)
questions.q: Is the data migration on track?
questions.expect: No: the Oct 9 status report said green/on track, but the RAID log (Oct 16) and the Oct 19 sync-up say it's about 2 weeks behind because of the legacy claim code mapping. Should flag the disagreement.
questions.answer: Not clearly — the sources disagree. The October 9 status report shows data migration as Green and on track for the December 1 code freeze [S1], but the newer RAID log (R-01, opened October 16) says legacy claim code mapping is incomplete and the migration is about 2 weeks behind plan [S4]. In the October 19 sync-up, about a third of old claim codes didn't map cleanly, and Ana warned that if mapping isn't done by month-end it will eat into the code freeze [S2][S6]. The later RAID entry is the more current picture, so the status report's Green rating looks out of date.
